difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the constructions described before it define a presheaf together with a canonical map from the given presheaf (statement lines 1992-1997). The proof is a short but complete verification: the only point to check is the compatibility of the composite of the restriction maps, which the author reduces to the canonical identification of a fibre product over an intermediate object with an iterated fibre product and to the corresponding correspondence between the restrictions of a compatible family (proof lines 2000-2013). The non-formal content is the identification of the restrictions. The claim is H1: a single written-out verification.
